name: plan_dish
description: Plan a finished dish the buyer names, for the number of portions, and add every ingredient to the basket as a priced line. It answers at once with a job_id and the basket_id; the plan itself takes about half a minute on the buyer's screen. Put the buyer's diet in must_claims and must_not_allergens. Use basket_id 'new' only when there is no basket yet. Right away call show_basket with the basket_id and tell the buyer it takes about half a minute. Wait for the context update that the dish is ready, then call get_basket and explain the new lines, the assumptions and the warnings. Never state a number that is not in a tool result.

dish.description: The finished dish in the buyer's words, Finnish or English, e.g. 'mansikkakakku'.

need_date.description: Delivery date the buyer needs, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Helsinki).

must_claims.description: GS1 claims the ingredients must carry where they make sense, e.g. ['FREE_FROM_LACTOSE'].

items.description: One item of: GS1 claims the ingredients must carry where they make sense, e.g. ['FREE_FROM_LACTOSE'].

must_not_allergens.description: GS1 allergen codes no ingredient may contain, e.g. ['AM'] only for milk-free or a milk allergy.

items.description: One item of: GS1 allergen codes no ingredient may contain, e.g. ['AM'] only for milk-free or a milk allergy.

language.description: The language the buyer speaks. Default: "fi".

basket_id.description: basket_id exactly as a basket tool returned it, or 'new' to start a new basket.
